_about: Topic library of the ranking / list compilation (Zero Yen Otaku). OWNER-EDITABLE. Entries are in RANK ORDER: the first entry is #1 (strongest / best). Check after any edit: python core/edit/ranking_topics.py check (refresh fills the AniList basis numbers: python core/edit/ranking_topics.py refresh).

_rules.order: power = community power-scaling consensus, checked against the 'above' pairs (canon head-to-heads / feats: the stronger one must rank higher) | fans = AniList favourites, high to low ('ranked by fans') | score = AniList average score, high to low (genre lists; the entries are ANIME, any good edit of that show).
_rules.reveal: countdown = #5, #4 (and usually #3) are shown, #2 / #1 stay blank as the comment hook (the reference format) | top = a 3-slot list counting down #3, #2, #1, every slot shown. Owner 2026-10-25: 'if he is mentioned as power level he should be 1' -> a power list with Rimuru pins him to #1 (pin: 1) and uses reveal 'top', so he is both the highest-ranked and SHOWN; no hidden slot ever claims someone stronger than him.
_rules.pin: an entry's 'pin': 1 (or 2, 3 ...) forces that rank; the checker fails a list where a pinned entry is elsewhere.
_rules.order_locked: true = the refresh never re-sorts this list (an owner override); the checker still reports how it differs from the basis.
_rules.entry: name = the on-screen name | chars = AniList character names (for a genre list: the show's main characters; any of them counts) | anime | search = the YouTube search phrase (default: the name) | tags = WD-tagger danbooru tags when the tagger knows the character | wiki = the show's Fandom wiki (reference pictures for the character check; the topic's wiki is the default) | max_dur = longest source upload allowed (default 150 s).
